{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (should be 6 with revenue 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Show sample of QA orders
qa_orders.head()"}
